# Spherical_Spin_Glass

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A disordered spin system with continuous degrees of freedom constrained to a sphere, exhibiting complex free-energy landscapes with many local minima. Serves as a canonical model for studying frustration and disorder in neuromorphic hardware, guiding the design of robust computational substrates with rich dynamics.
